fallback.field: Help for "{{label}}" is not yet authored. This field currently operates with system defaults; ask your administrator for the precise definition.

users.username: Login username. After creation it is the account's unique identifier and must follow the organization's naming rules. users.username TEXT NOT NULL; unique together with organization_id — cannot repeat within the same organization
users.displayName: Display name used as the readable identifier in lists, approvals, and notifications. user_profiles.display_name TEXT, nullable; independent from username, freely editable
users.email: Email address used for sign-in, password recovery, and notifications. It must be a deliverable address. user_profiles.email TEXT nullable; when non-empty it must be globally unique (unique_partial on email IS NOT NULL). Format only is validated — deliverability is not checked
users.phone: Phone number used for SMS codes, multi-factor authentication, and security notices. user_profiles.phone TEXT nullable; one phone number may be bound to multiple user accounts
users.password: Initial password. It must satisfy the password policy; users should change it after the first sign-in. user_credentials.password_hash VARCHAR(255) Argon2id hash; user_credentials.need_update_password BOOLEAN can force change on first sign-in; API never returns original
users.userType: User type, which determines whether the account is a regular user, a service account, or an external user. users.user_type VARCHAR(255) default ''; allowed values human / service_account / bot; empty treated as human
users.status: Account status. Disabled accounts cannot sign in, but their data and audit trail are kept. users.status VARCHAR(64) default 'active'; check IN ('active','disabled','locked','pending_verification'); disabled/locked/pending_verification all reject sign-in
users.organizationId: Owning organization, which defines the tenant boundary and the data visible to this account. users.organization_id UUID NOT NULL; FK to organizations.id, on_delete RESTRICT (organization cannot be deleted while users exist)
users.isAdmin: Grants organization administrator rights. Administrators manage users and settings of this organization. users.is_admin BOOLEAN default false; when true the user bypasses role-based permission checks and gains full management rights
users.roleBindingIds: Bound roles, which define the permission set the user holds inside this organization. user_role_bindings composite PK (user_id, role_id); supports starts_at/expires_at time windows; CASCADE on role delete; multiple roles stack
users.groupIds: Member groups, used for bulk authorization and policy matching. user_group_memberships composite PK (user_id, group_id); one user can belong to many groups; each relation is a separate row; CASCADE on user or group delete

organizations.name: Unique organization identifier used in sign-in URLs, API paths, and tenant isolation. Avoid changing it after creation. Implementation detail: this field maps to organizations.slug TEXT NOT NULL (application-level naming), unique_partial on slug + deleted_at IS NULL; globally unique; changing it breaks tenant routing and RLS predicates
organizations.displayName: Organization display name shown in the console header and notifications. organizations.display_name TEXT NOT NULL; freely editable, does not affect routing or RLS
organizations.slug: Short organization identifier used for domains and sign-in entry points. Must be globally unique. organizations.slug TEXT NOT NULL; unique_partial on slug + deleted_at IS NULL; login URLs derived as {slug}.guliangiam.example.com — changing slug invalidates the old sign-in URL
organizations.logoUrl: Organization logo URL shown on the sign-in page and in the console sidebar. organizations.logo_url TEXT nullable; HTTP/HTTPS public image URL recommended; logo_dark_url covers dark-theme variant

theme.name: Theme preset name used by the console. Choose a preset or type your own.
theme.tokens: Ant Design token overrides applied to this organization's console.
theme.customCss: CSS appended to the console for this organization. Invalid rules are ignored by the browser.

applications.name: Application name used by users to recognize the application on the consent screen. applications.display_name TEXT NOT NULL; display-only, not used in routing or auth computation
applications.slug: Unique application identifier used in callback URLs and the OIDC discovery document. applications.slug TEXT NOT NULL; uq_applications_org_slug (organization_id, slug); cannot repeat within one org; OIDC discovery doc follows /oauth2/{slug}/.well-known/openid-configuration
applications.redirectUris: Allowed callback URL whitelist. Unregistered URLs are rejected to prevent token interception. app_oauth_config.redirect_uris VARCHAR(255)[] default '{}'; each URL must match verbatim (including path and query params); supports wildcard path segments *, but NOT protocol or host wildcards
applications.clientId: OAuth/OIDC client identifier. It is public information and may appear in the frontend. applications.client_id TEXT nullable; globally unique when non-empty (uq_applications_client_id_non_empty); system-generated UUID on app creation but can be overridden manually; client_id appears as the public identifier in authorization_code / device_code token_endpoint requests
applications.clientSecret: Client secret. Keep it on the server only; never expose it in the frontend or logs. app_oauth_config.client_secret_hash TEXT nullable; app_client_secrets table seals each (Argon2id + secret_prefix gl_cs_); multi-secret rotation supported (status active/grace/retired with grace_until transition); API never returns the original, only prefix + SHA-256 fingerprint
applications.grantTypes: Allowed grant types, which determine the sign-in flows this application may initiate. app_oauth_config.grant_types VARCHAR(255)[] default '{}'; supports authorization_code / client_credentials / refresh_token / device_code / urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer; at least one must be enabled before the app can actually authorize

resources.name: Unique resource identifier used for resource matching in permission policies. resources.name TEXT NOT NULL; uq_resources_org_app_name (organization_id, application_id, name); composite uniqueness — name cannot repeat within the same application
resources.displayName: Resource display name used on permission configuration screens. resources.display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL default ''; display-only, not used in policy matching
resources.type: Resource type, which determines the available actions and how policies match it. resources.type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL default 'file'; values defined by the Casbin model (typically file / data / api); type defines the permitted actions enum
resources.applicationId: Owning application. Resource permissions are granted and revoked together with the application. resources.application_id UUID nullable; FK to applications.id, on_delete SET_NULL (resources survive app deletion without owner); permissions are granted and revoked at the application_id granularity

roles.name: Role name used for permission assignment and audit records. roles.name TEXT NOT NULL; uq_roles_org_name (organization_id, name); cannot repeat within one org
roles.description: Role description covering the job functions and permission scope this role is meant for. roles.description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL default ''; purely descriptive, not used in permission calculation; roles.is_enabled BOOLEAN default true can disable the role globally

groups.name: Group name used for bulk authorization and directory synchronization. groups.name TEXT NOT NULL; uq_groups_organization_id_name (organization_id, name); hierarchical (groups.parent_id self-FK, on_delete RESTRICT)
groups.displayName: Group display name. groups.display_name TEXT NOT NULL default ''; in hierarchy, parent is displayed first, falling back to name

account.emailHelp: Current account email used for sign-in, password recovery, and security notices. user_profiles.email TEXT nullable, unique_partial (deleted_at IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL) guarantees global uniqueness when non-empty; changes require verification via the old email or phone; recovery entry points update automatically after change.
account.phoneHelp: Current account phone used for MFA and security notices. user_profiles.phone TEXT nullable, non-unique (one phone may bind to multiple accounts); changes require SMS code verification; used for SMS MFA and security-event notifications.

settings.siteName: Console site name shown in the browser title and on the sign-in page. application.title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL default ''; read from the current signed-in app; changes take effect immediately on sign-in-page title and browser tab
settings.logoUrl: Site logo URL shown on the sign-in page and in the console. application.logo VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL default ''; read from the current app; organization.logo_url TEXT is the org-level override, preferred when present

systemInfo.autoRefreshHelp: When enabled, polls GET /api/v1/system/info every 30 seconds (system_info endpoint returns JSONB metrics); when disabled, loads once on first page enter and requires manual refresh afterwards; this switch is persisted in browser localStorage and does not affect backend behavior.

rebac.namespaces: ReBAC namespaces define object types and the relations authorization checks may traverse. relation_namespaces UUID PK; name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL unique namespace identifier; relation_defs JSONB array (each element has relation + from_type + to_type); subject→object traversal follows relation_defs during auth checks; CASCADE cleanup of all relation_tuples when namespace is deleted.
rebac.tuples: Relation tuples store the subject-relation-object facts every ReBAC check evaluates against. relation_tuples UUID PK; composite unique uq_relation_tuples (organization_id, namespace_id, subject, relation, object); zookie VARCHAR(64) serves as traversal cursor (zookie ASC guarantees traversal order); ReBAC engine matches relation_defs and queries relation_tuples for facts during subject→object traversal; every write is captured via outbox events (outbox.type = rebac.tuple.added/removed) and pushed in real time.

workload.pools: Identity pools group federation trusts and service accounts workloads use to obtain credentials. tenant_instances carries the pool; isolation_tier VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('row','schema','database') determines isolation level (workload pools typically use row-level + RLS); each pool contains multiple federation_trusts (OIDC issuer + subject_pattern) and multiple service_accounts; tenant_identities tracks provisioning status (status VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('pending','provisioning','active','failed')).
workload.trusts: Federation trusts list external OIDC issuers and subject patterns this pool accepts. federation_trusts UUID PK; issuer VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL (OIDC discovery URL prefix); subject_pattern VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL (regex, e.g. '^system:serviceaccount:.*' or '*'); audience JSONB (JWT aud allowlist); expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ (trust cert validity, auto-alert 30 days before expiry); JWT verification requires issuer exact match + subject_pattern regex hit + audience contains — all three simultaneously.
workload.serviceAccounts: Service accounts issue scoped, short-lived credentials for workloads in this pool. tenant_service_accounts UUID PK; credential_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('long_lived_secret','assume_role','federated_token'); scope JSONB (granted permission scope); credential_ttl TIMESTAMPTZ (credential validity, max 24h); credential issuance triggers outbox event (type = workload.credential_issued), consumed by metering and enters the llm_usage_logs billing chain (DECIMAL(19,4) cost_amount column).

metering.events: Raw usage events recorded per request, for逐条核对计费调用. llm_metering_events JSONB payload stores full event copy; synced from outbox events (outbox.type = llm.usage.logged); immutable append-only, dedup key is outbox_id (unique constraint); each event includes provider_type, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, cost_amount, etc.
metering.aggregates: Usage aggregated per account and period, for billing settlement and quota review. llm_usage_logs UUID PK, partitioned by month (PARTITION BY RANGE created_at), aggregated by (api_key_id, alias_id, provider_id, created_at); computation window is UTC natural day/natural month; aggregates are written to llm_metering_aggregates DECIMAL(19,4).

risk.signals: Risk signals collected from sign-in context, device, and behavior, scored per event. risk_signals table: device_fingerprint VARCHAR(255), ip_geo JSONB, behavioral_patterns JSONB; each signal has an independent score SMALLINT (0–100); final risk level risk_leverage = SUM(signal.score * weight) mapped to low/medium/high.
risk.decisions: Allow / challenge / deny decisions produced by risk rules, with reason attached. risk_decisions table: result CHECK IN ('allow','challenge','deny'), reason TEXT, rule_ids JSONB; allow = continue sign-in, challenge = force MFA re-verification, deny = block and write audit.risk_blocked; all decisions are immutable.
risk.sessionGovernance: Continuous session evaluation: risk changes can trigger re-MFA or direct revocation. session_governance table: evaluation interval 180s (backend heartbeat scheduled trigger); risk_level VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('low','medium','high','critical'); risk escalation triggers action VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('re_mfa','revoke'); all changes are written to audit.session_governance for audit replay.

actions.list: Identity actions are automated workflows that react to identity lifecycle events. identity_actions table: triggered by outbox events (outbox.type IN ('user.created','user.role_bound','user.group_changed','user.activated','user.disabled')); each action defines multi-step (steps JSONB array) and retry_policy (retry_count SMALLINT default 0 + retry_backoff VARCHAR(32) default 'exponential'); action execution results are written to action_execution_log (payload JSONB).
actions.versions: Version history of action definitions, for reviewing changes and rollback. identity_action_versions table: version_no INTEGER auto-incremented on each publish; active version tracked by identity_actions.active_version_no; rollback re-executes all affected outbox events; each version carries checksum VARCHAR(64) SHA-256 for tamper-evidence.
actions.executionLogs: Per-run execution records for actions, including target, outcome, and error detail. action_execution_log UUID PK (composite of action_id + version_no + run_id); status VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('pending','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled'); payload JSONB stores per-step input/output/error; failed entries can be retried (retry_count SMALLINT, retries do not change version_no); TTL 30 days for archive.

iga.requests: User-submitted access requests, with approvers, justification, and grant state. iga_access_requests UUID PK; status VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled','expired'); three-level approval chain (submitter → approver1 → approver2), approver1 is direct manager, approver2 is department head; 7-day SLA per node (CHECK sla_hours SMALLINT default 168); auto-escalates to upper approver, then auto-rejects if still not handled, notifying the requester.
iga.campaigns: Access review campaigns where reviewers certify or revoke existing access. iga_access_review_campaigns UUID PK; deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL fixed cutoff; reviewer_id FK to reviewer user; recommendation VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('certify','revoke','delegate'); unreviewed accesses auto-enter PENDING_REVOKE at deadline, auto-revoke (hard-delete role_binding / group_membership) after 14 days suspended, all results written to audit.log (TEXT immutable audit log).
iga.sodRules: Separation-of-duties rules that flag permission combinations one identity must not hold simultaneously. iga_sod_rules UUID PK; rule_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('role_pair','permission_set','data_domain'); rule engine evaluates cross-product of user_role_bindings + user_group_memberships; hits block new bindings (409 Conflict) and alert approvers via notification channels; daily 00:00 UTC full evaluation, incremental evaluation on role_bound events.
iga.lifecycle: Lifecycle policies that grant and revoke access on join/move/leave events. lifecycle_policies UUID PK; trigger_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('on_join','on_move','on_leave','on_contract_end'); policy config is JSONB (roles_to_grant / groups_to_add / permissions_to_revoke); triggered by SCIM provisioning / invitation / admin_create events (outbox.type = user.*); results written to outbox (type = lifecycle.permissions_changed), then consumed by the metering chain.
iga.privilegedSessions: Just-in-time privileged sessions with approval, recording, and auto-expiry. privileged_sessions UUID PK; request_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('just_in_time','break_glass','temporary_admin'); default TTL 3600s (1h), max 28800s (8h), CHECK CONSTRAINT ttl_sec BETWEEN 60 AND 28800; approval uses the same access_request 3-level chain; records full operation trail (API call + request body + response, written to audit.privileged_session_recordings JSONB); auto-revokes at expiry (user_role_bindings.expires_at = now() triggers cascade cleanup), notifying the approver.

providers.unified: All provider families in one list, filterable by category and type. providers UUID PK; family VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('identity','ai','payment','notification','workload'); kind VARCHAR(64) (100+ enums under identity family, ai family is openai/anthropic/gemini/deepseek/glm/kimi/qwen/seed/ollama/vllm/custom); supported_domains JSONB (domain list the provider is associated with); secrets are sealed with Argon2id (secret VARCHAR(512)) + SHA-256 fingerprint.
providers.captcha: Captcha providers for sign-in and registration forms to block automated abuse. captcha_providers UUID PK; site_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL (frontend embed); secret_key VARCHAR(512) Argon2id-sealed; provider_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('recaptcha_v2','recaptcha_v3','hcaptcha','turnstile','geetest','aliyun_captcha','tencent_captcha'); is_enabled BOOLEAN default true (global switch — when disabled, ALL captchas are skipped).
providers.notification: Notification channels for verification codes, alerts, and security notices. notification_providers UUID PK; channel VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('email','sms','dingtalk','lark','wecom','slack','telegram','webhook','apns','fcm'); sealed_config JSONB (Argon2id-sealed sensitive config); supported_templates JSONB (per-scene template variable mapping); is_enabled BOOLEAN default true; multiple providers per channel allowed, distributed by priority.
providers.faceId: Face recognition providers for identity verification during sign-in or enrollment. face_id_providers UUID PK; provider_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK IN ('aliyun_face_body','onfido','veriff','persona','aws_rekognition'); access_key_id VARCHAR(255) + access_key_secret VARCHAR(512) Argon2id-sealed; endpoint VARCHAR(500) third-party API URL; config JSONB (model version / liveness threshold / concurrency limit); is_enabled BOOLEAN default true (global switch — when disabled, ALL face_id verifications are skipped).

permissions.structured: Point-and-click policy editor for subjects, resources, and actions; best for common cases. permissions UUID PK; subject_types JSONB (supports user / group / role / domain); resource_types JSONB (supports file / data / api / ai_model, etc.); actions JSONB (per-resource-type action enum); effect VARCHAR(64) default 'Allow'; saves directly into Casbin RBAC/ABAC model p-policies; enforcer hot-reloads without restart.
permissions.advanced: Raw policy text for complex conditions; changes take effect after saving and reloading. permissions.raw_policy TEXT (Casbin model syntax); supports p (policy), g (grouping), r (request definition) sections; on save: go-casbin parse + syntax validation + atomic in-memory enforcer replacement; on failure, auto-rollback to last loadable version (permissions.previous_raw_policy TEXT).

application.previewHelp: Live preview of the sign-in page with the current branding settings. Pure frontend rendering, NO backend writes; reads organization.branding JSONB (logo / primary_color / background_image / font_family / custom_css_url) + organization_theme_settings JSONB (dark mode / rounded corners / animation toggles) in real time; preview updates immediately after any change; device-size switchable (desktop 1440px / tablet 768px / mobile 375px); cookie/localStorage changes during preview do not pollute real session.
application.signinPreviewHelp: Preview of sign-in form layout and fields as end users will see them. Pure frontend rendering, NO backend writes; signin_items JSONB array (from organization_settings.signin_items) defines field order and types (username / email / phone / qrcode / cas / saml); signin_methods JSONB array (from app_signin_config.signin_methods) defines available sign-in methods (password / mfa / social_provider); device-size switchable; preview content NEVER affects the live sign-in page (live page is generated per app-routing + organization_settings at request time).
application.styleCodeHelp: Shows the HTML/CSS that is actually submitted for this application.

concept.name: Unique identifier of this object. It is used in URLs and audit records and usually cannot be changed after creation. （Internal UUID primary key, system-generated on creation, unique within the table; cannot be manually assigned or modified）
concept.displayName: Human-readable name shown in lists and detail pages. Unlike the identifier, it can be edited at any time. （TEXT type; used for list display and detail pages; not used for authorization; editable at any time）
concept.status: Current lifecycle state of this object. Inactive or disabled objects keep their data but reject new operations. （Enum varies per entity: users has active/disabled/locked/pending_verification; llm_providers has active/disabled/testing; outbox has pending/processing/succeeded/failed/dead; llm_api_keys has active/revoked/expired）
concept.statusLabel: Localized label of the current state, used for filtering and for quick scanning in lists. （Localized label for the status field shown in UI; actual enum values depend on the entity type）
concept.type: Kind of this object. The selected type decides which fields, validation rules, and downstream behavior apply. （VARCHAR/TEXT type; actual values depend on the table: providers.family supports identity/ai/payment/notification; users.user_type supports human/service_account/bot）
concept.organizationId: Organization that owns this object. Data is isolated per organization and other tenants cannot see or modify it. （UUID type, NOT NULL; acts as the tenant isolation key for RLS predicates; all data tables enforce filtering by this column）
concept.orgId: Organization that owns this object. Data is isolated per organization and other tenants cannot see or modify it. （Alias for organizationId; UUID type, NOT NULL; tenant isolation primary key）
concept.organization: Organization this record belongs to. It determines the tenant boundary of the data. （Owning organization; organizations.status defaults to active, parent_id can be NULL meaning root org; RLS restricts access to current org's data）
concept.description: Free-form notes for operators. The text is shown in detail views and audit exports but never used for authorization. （TEXT/VARCHAR(255) type; roles/permissions/models description defaults to empty string; not used for authorization）
concept.enabled: Turns this capability on or off. Disabled items stay configured but are skipped at runtime. （BOOLEAN type; defaults vary by table: providers defaults to TRUE; applications defaults FALSE (is_portal) / TRUE (is_visible); disabled entries keep all config but are skipped at runtime）
concept.isEnabled: Turns this capability on or off. Disabled items stay configured but are skipped at runtime. （Alias for enabled; BOOLEAN type with varying defaults per table; disabled entries keep config but are skipped at runtime）
concept.endpoint: Full URL of the remote service, including scheme and path. It must be reachable from the server, not just from your browser. （VARCHAR(255~500) type including scheme and path; providers.provider_url is VARCHAR(255); llm_providers.base_url is VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL）
concept.host: Hostname or IP address of the target service. Do not include the scheme or path here. （VARCHAR(255) type without scheme or path; both provider and syncers tables have this column with empty string default）
concept.port: TCP port of the target service. Leave empty to use the protocol default. （INTEGER type; providers and syncers default to 0; 0 means use the protocol's default port）
concept.username: Login name used to authenticate against this service. It is stored as plain configuration, not as a user credential. （TEXT/VARCHAR type depending on the table; users.username is TEXT and unique within organization; providers.username is VARCHAR(255) with empty string default）
concept.password: Secret used together with the username. It is write-only: after saving, the value is masked and never returned in full. （Stored as Argon2id hash, fixed 60-char digest; user_credentials.password_hash VARCHAR(255); API never returns the original password, only a mask）
concept.email: Primary email address used for sign-in, notifications, and account recovery. （TEXT type; users.email is stored in user_profiles table, nullable; unique within organization via partial unique on deleted_at IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL）
concept.phone: Mobile number in international format. It is used for SMS verification and must be unique within the organization when required. （TEXT type, user_profiles.phone nullable; unique within organization with same partial unique as email）
concept.title: Short heading shown to users in lists, cards, and notifications. (applications.title VARCHAR(255), NOT NULL, default empty string)
concept.tags: Labels attached to this object for grouping and filtering. Tags do not grant permissions. （VARCHAR(255)[] array type; applications.tags defaults to empty array; JSONB type represents structured tags in other tables）
concept.tag: Single label attached to this object for grouping and filtering. （VARCHAR(255) single-value type; users.tag defaults to empty string, used for internal cohorting with no schema constraint）
concept.scope: Permission scope requested or granted by this object. Narrower scopes reduce the impact if a credential leaks. （JSONB/VARCHAR type; llm_quota_policies.scope has CHECK constraint: organization/api_key/alias）
concept.model: Model or policy model this record refers to. It controls which resources and actions the rule can address. （UUID foreign key; enforcers.model_id UUID nullable; policy engine model definition; llm_models stores physical AI models）
concept.price: Unit price in the smallest currency unit expected by the billing engine. Tax is calculated separately. （DECIMAL(19,4) type; llm_price_versions.input_price_per_1m and output_price_per_1m default to 0; price per 1M tokens）
concept.currency: Currency of all amounts on this record. Changing it affects billing and must match the payment channel. （VARCHAR(3) type; organization_billing defaults to USD; user_financials defaults to USD; llm_api_keys defaults to USD; future transactions are billed under the new currency after change）
concept.quantity: Number of units to grant or charge. It multiplies the unit price when totals are calculated. （INTEGER type; billing quantity; automatically metered by llm_usage_logs token counts）
concept.region: Geographic region of the provider or resource. It determines data residency and the API endpoint used. （VARCHAR(255) type; deployment_regions.region_code is TEXT with unique constraint; tenant_instances.data_residency_country is VARCHAR(2) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2）
concept.method: HTTP method used when calling the remote endpoint. Match the method the provider documents. （VARCHAR(64) type; webhooks.method defaults to 'POST'; must match provider documentation）
concept.contentType: Content type sent with the request body, for example application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded. （VARCHAR(64) type; webhooks.content_type defaults to 'application/json'; providers.content_type defaults to empty string）
concept.ipWhitelist: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to use this credential. Requests from other addresses are rejected. （VARCHAR(255) type, semicolon-separated CIDR list; users.ip_whitelist defaults to empty string; when non-empty, login/API requests are restricted to these ranges）
concept.state: Current state of this record in its workflow. State changes are written to the audit log. （Workflow state field; some tables have CHECK constraints: llm_provider_health uses healthy/degraded/open/half_open; user_identities.link_state uses auto_linked/merge_pending/linked/rejected）
concept.priority: Evaluation order for competing rules. Lower numbers are evaluated first; ties fall back to creation time. （INTEGER type; llm_providers and llm_routes default to 100; lower values have higher priority）
concept.sslMode: TLS mode for the connection. Prefer verify-full in production so the server certificate is validated. （VARCHAR(64) type; syncers default to disable; supports enum: disable/allow/prefer/require/verify-ca/verify-full）
concept.balance: Current available balance for this account. It changes as transactions and refunds are recorded. （DECIMAL(19,4), default 0; stored independently in organization_billing and user_financials tables, do not affect each other）
concept.homepage: Public URL of the application or provider home page. It is shown on consent and sign-in screens. （TEXT/VARCHAR type; applications.homepage_url TEXT nullable; used for consent page display）
concept.location: Physical or logical location of this record, used for grouping and reporting only. （TEXT type; user_profiles.location nullable; only used for grouping and reporting）
concept.countryCode: ISO country code used to derive the dialing prefix and regional defaults. （VARCHAR(2) type; deployment_regions.country_code has CHECK char_length(country_code) = 2）
concept.verificationCode: One-time code sent to the bound email or phone. It expires quickly and can be used once. （One-time token in verifications table, code TEXT; expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL is required; status VARCHAR(64) defaults to pending; auto-expires at deadline）
concept.subject: Subject the assertion or rule applies to, usually a user, service account, or group identifier. （TEXT type; user_identities.subject VARCHAR(255); relation_tuples.subject TEXT; subject_relation supports null; user_identities has uq_identity_provider_subject unique constraint）
concept.certificate: Public certificate in PEM format. The matching private key must be configured separately. （PEM public certificate; app_client_certificates.certificate_pem TEXT type; private-key JWK fields (d/p/q/dp/dq/qi/k) are rejected on upload, only the public portion is kept）
concept.admin: Grants organization administrator privileges. Administrators can manage members, roles, and settings. （BOOLEAN type; users.is_admin defaults to false; when true bypasses role-based permission checks; org super admin belongs to built-in org that cannot be decommissioned）
concept.birthday: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD. It is used for age policy checks and never shown to other users. （DATE type, user_profiles.birthday nullable; used for age policy checks）
concept.ranking: Sort weight for display order. Higher values appear earlier when no explicit order is set. （INTEGER type; applications.menu_order defaults to 0; higher values appear earlier）
concept.domain: Domain name served by this application. It must resolve to the gateway and match the TLS certificate. （VARCHAR(253) type; organization_domains.domain has unique constraint; must resolve to the service gateway and match TLS certificate）
concept.subDomains: Additional hostnames accepted for this application, separated by commas. Wildcards are not supported. （VARCHAR(255)[] array type; app_network_config.other_domains defaults to empty array; wildcards not supported）
concept.logo: Brand image shown on sign-in and consent pages. Recommended size is 200x200 with a transparent background. （VARCHAR(255) type; applications.logo defaults to empty string; organization branding supports enable_dark_logo BOOLEAN）
concept.favicon: Small icon shown in the browser tab. Use a square image of at least 32x32 pixels. （VARCHAR(255) type; applications.favicon defaults to empty string; recommended at least 32×32 square image）
concept.redirectUri: Callback URLs allowed after sign-in. Every value must match exactly what the client sends, including the path. （VARCHAR(255)[] array type; app_oauth_config.redirect_uris defaults to empty array; every value must match exactly what the OAuth/OIDC client sends (including path and query params)）
concept.clientId: Public identifier of the OAuth client. It is safe to expose in browser and mobile applications. （applications.client_id TEXT nullable; partial unique when client_id <> ''; auto-generated or manually specified when non-empty）
concept.clientSecret: Confidential secret of the OAuth client. Store it only on the server and rotate it if it leaks. （app_client_secrets.secret_hash VARCHAR(255) Argon2id hash; status CHECK constraint active/grace/retired; API never returns the original secret, only a prefix gl_cs_ + first 6 random characters）
concept.signinUrl: URL users are sent to for sign-in. Use the complete authorize endpoint, not only the host. （VARCHAR(255) type; app_signin_config.signin_url defaults to empty string; needs full authorize endpoint）
concept.logoutUrl: URL called to end the session at the identity provider after local sign-out. （VARCHAR(255) type; app_signin_config.logout_url defaults to empty string; used for single sign-out）
concept.samlMetadata: SAML metadata XML or its URL. It supplies the entity ID, signing certificate, and endpoints. （TEXT type; app_saml_config.saml_metadata stores IdP SAML XML; alternatively saml_metadata_url VARCHAR(2048) can point to metadata URL）
concept.idpUrl: Identity provider endpoint used to start SAML or OIDC sign-in. （VARCHAR(255) type; providers.auth_url/token_url/user_info_url each have independent URLs; used for SAML/OIDC login flow）
concept.spEntityId: Service provider entity ID presented to the identity provider. It must match the value registered there. （VARCHAR(255) type; providers.idp_entity_id defaults to empty string; Service Provider entity ID in SAML protocol）
concept.attributes: Attribute mapping between the identity provider assertion and local user fields. （JSONB type; app_saml_config.saml_attributes defaults to empty array; stores IdP attribute to local user field mappings）
concept.script: Script executed by the policy engine. It runs with the permissions of the engine, so review changes carefully. （TEXT/VARCHAR type; executed by policy engine; runs with engine's own permissions）
concept.rule: Rule expression evaluated for each matching request. The first matching rule decides the outcome when configured that way. （UUID primary key; casbin_rules has uq_casbin_rules_rule full unique constraint (ptype+v0~v5); supports ptype=p/g/r/e）
concept.expression: Condition expression in the engine syntax. Empty means the rule matches every request. （VARCHAR type; CASBIN ptype/v0~v5 are VARCHAR(255) defaulting to empty string; empty expression means rule matches every request）
concept.resourceType: Category of resource the policy addresses, such as an application, API, or data object. （VARCHAR(255) type, permissions.resource_type defaults to empty string; used together with resources JSONB array）
concept.resources: Resources this rule applies to. Leave empty to apply to all resources of the selected type. （JSONB array type; permissions.resources defaults to empty array; resources table has uq_resources_org_app_name unique constraint）
concept.actions: Operations allowed on the selected resources, for example read, write, or delete. （JSONB array type; permissions.actions defaults to empty array; used together with resource_type and resources）
concept.effect: Whether the matched request is allowed or denied. Deny rules take precedence over allow rules. （VARCHAR(64) type; permissions.effect defaults to 'Allow'; Deny rules take precedence over Allow）
concept.sorter: Order in which policies are evaluated. Lower values run first and can short-circuit later rules. （VARCHAR(255) type; permissions.sorter defaults to empty string; lower values evaluated first）
concept.subUsers: Sub-users covered by this permission, usually delegated accounts acting on behalf of the owner. （JSONB/VARCHAR type; permissions.subUsers defaults to empty string; used in sub-user delegation scenarios）
concept.adapter: Adapter used to interpret policies and queries. It must match the model configured on the enforcer. （UUID foreign key; enforcers.adapter_id UUID nullable; adapter table has uq_adapters_org_name unique constraint; type VARCHAR(64) defaults to 'database'）
concept.application: Application this record belongs to. It determines which sign-in policy and branding are applied. （UUID foreign key; applications.status defaults to active; application_id serves as FK to multiple tables with on_delete CASCADE）
concept.providerType: Provider family, such as OAuth, SAML, SMS, or face recognition. It decides which credentials are required. （Dual-field structure: providers.family (identity/ai/payment/notification) + providers.kind; ai family's kind is openai/anthropic/gemini/deepseek/glm/kimi/qwen/seed/ollama/vllm/custom; llm_providers.provider_type CHECK matches ai family kind）
concept.customHeader: Extra HTTP headers sent with each request. Use one header per line in name: value form. （VARCHAR(255) type; providers.custom_header defaults to empty string; one header per line in name: value format）
concept.timeout: Maximum wait time in seconds before the request is aborted and reported as a timeout. （INTEGER type; webhooks.timeout_ms defaults to 5000ms; llm_providers.request_timeout_ms defaults to 30000ms）
concept.retries: Number of automatic retries after a retryable failure. Retries reuse the same request body. （INTEGER type; llm_providers.max_retries defaults to 2; webhooks.max_retries defaults to 3; outbox.max_attempts defaults to 12）
concept.interval: Interval between scheduled runs, in seconds unless another unit is stated. （INTEGER type in seconds; webhooks.retry_interval defaults to 60; device_auth_codes.poll_interval_sec defaults to 5）
concept.cron: Cron expression for the schedule. Use five fields (minute hour day month weekday). （VARCHAR type; used for scheduled task scheduling; syncers.sync_interval INTEGER defaults to 0 meaning no sync）
concept.timezone: Time zone used to interpret schedules and displayed timestamps. （VARCHAR(255) type; deployment_regions.timezone defaults to empty string; used for interpreting schedules and timestamp display）
concept.language: Default interface language for this scope. Users can still override it in their own profile. （JSONB array type; organization_settings.languages defaults to empty array; supports multi-language configuration）
concept.theme: Visual theme applied to the console. It only affects presentation, not permissions. （VARCHAR(255) type; organization_theme_settings.theme_name defaults to empty string; tokens JSONB stores specific theme variables）
concept.layout: Layout preset for the console shell, such as side navigation or top navigation. （VARCHAR(64) type; organization_settings.account_menu defaults to 'horizontal'; options are horizontal or side）
concept.navItems: Menu entries visible to members of this scope. Removing an entry hides it without deleting any data. (organization_settings.nav_preferences JSONB; empty object means use system default nav items)
concept.mfaItems: Multi-factor methods offered during sign-in. At least one should stay enabled for administrators. （JSONB array type; organization_settings.mfa_items defaults to empty array; user_collections.mfa_items used together; keep at least one to avoid admin lockout）
concept.signinItems: Sign-in methods shown on the login page, such as password, SMS, or social providers. （JSONB array type; app_signin_config.signin_items defaults to empty array; co-acts with signin_methods TEXT[]）
concept.expireTime: Expiry time of this object. After it passes, the object stops working and must be renewed. （TIMESTAMPTZ type; authorization_codes and device_auth_codes expires_at is required; verifications.expires_at NOT NULL defaults to now() + interval）
concept.owner: Owner of this record. Owners can edit it and receive lifecycle notifications. （VARCHAR(255) type; models.owner and enforcers.owner default to empty string; record owner）
concept.user: User this record refers to. The selection is limited to members of the current organization. （UUID primary key; users table has uq_users_org_username_active partial unique constraint; is_deleted BOOLEAN soft-delete marker）
concept.group: Group this record refers to. Group membership is evaluated when permissions are checked. （UUID primary key; groups table has uq_groups_organization_id_name unique constraint; parent_id self-reference supports tree structure; user_group_memberships implements many-to-many）
concept.role: Role assigned to the subject. Roles bundle permissions and are evaluated at sign-in and on each request. （UUID primary key; roles table has uq_roles_org_name unique constraint; is_enabled defaults to true; permissions bundled as JSONB）
concept.permission: Permission entry attached to this object. It defines which actions are allowed on which resources. （UUID primary key; permissions.effect defaults to 'Allow'; Deny takes precedence over Allow; resource_type + resources JSONB + actions JSONB jointly define authorization scope）
concept.token: Credential token used for API access. Treat it as a secret and rotate it on a schedule. （VARCHAR(255) type; agents.token defaults to empty string; API never returns original credential, only a mask）
concept.key: Key material or key identifier used for signing and verification. Private parts are never displayed in full. （Mixed type: API Key is VARCHAR(20~128); llm_api_keys uses key_prefix VARCHAR(20) + key_hash VARCHAR(128) stored separately）
concept.secret: Secret value paired with the client or key. It is write-only and masked after saving. （TEXT/VARCHAR(255) type; providers.client_secret and app_secret are TEXT nullable; stored as Argon2id hash or Sealed Envelope）
concept.hash: Hashed credential value. Only the hash is stored, so the original value cannot be recovered. （TEXT/VARCHAR(255) type; authorization_codes.code_hash TEXT with unique index; user_credentials.password_hash VARCHAR(255) Argon2id）
concept.algorithm: Algorithm used for signing, hashing, or encryption. It must be supported by the peer service. （Context-aware enum: app_oauth_config.token_signing_method limited to RS256/SM2-SM3; app_client_jwks.alg limited to RS256/PS256/ES256; token_endpoint_auth_method supports none/client_secret_basic/client_secret_post/private_key_jwt/tls_client_auth/self_signed_tls_client_auth）
concept.privateKey: Private key in PEM format. It signs assertions or requests and must never be shared. （System rejects JWK with private key fields (d/p/q/dp/dq/qi/k); app_client_jwks.jwk JSONB only keeps public portion; private key must be managed by caller）
concept.publicKey: Public key corresponding to the private key. It is safe to publish for verification. （JSONB type; app_client_jwks.jwk stores public JWK; app_client_certificates.certificate_pem stores public certificate PEM）
concept.metadata: Structured metadata stored with this record. Values are shown in detail views and API responses. （JSONB/TEXT/VARCHAR type; provider_configs.config JSONB defaults to empty object; saml_metadata TEXT stores SAML XML）
concept.config: Provider-specific configuration. Required keys depend on the selected provider type. （JSONB type; provider_configs uses config_type + config dual-field; config JSONB defaults to empty object; updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ records last modification time）
concept.mode: Operating mode of this component. Some modes change which fields are required. （VARCHAR(16) type; organization_policy_inheritance.mode has CHECK IN ('inherit', 'override', 'lock')）
concept.format: Serialization format used when reading or writing this value. （VARCHAR/TEXT type; no database constraint; serialization format determined by API request parameters）
concept.locale: Locale identifier such as en-US or zh-CN, used for date, number, and text formatting. （VARCHAR/TEXT type, format like en-US, zh-CN; used for date, number, and text formatting）
concept.pageSize: Number of rows requested per page. Larger values load more data but take longer. （INTEGER type; only used for API query parameters; no direct database constraint）
concept.from: Start of the time range, inclusive. Times are interpreted in the selected time zone. （TIMESTAMPTZ type; start of API query time range, inclusive; interpreted with timezone field）
concept.to: End of the time range, inclusive. It must be later than the start time. （TIMESTAMPTZ type; end of API query time range, inclusive; must be later than start）
concept.amount: Monetary amount for this record, expressed in the selected currency. （DECIMAL(19,4) type; llm_usage_logs.cost_amount defaults to 0; transaction amount expressed in selected currency）
concept.plan: Subscription plan this record refers to. The plan defines quotas, features, and renewal rules. （VARCHAR/TEXT type; commercial subscription plan; determines quota and renewal rules）
concept.remark: Operator note saved with the record. It is visible to administrators and in exports. （VARCHAR(255)/TEXT type; serves as operator note only; written to audit log）
concept.reason: Justification for this action. It is written to the audit log and shown to approvers. （TEXT/VARCHAR type; justification for the action; written to audit log）
concept.comment: Comment added to the record. Comments never change the object state. （TEXT type; does not change object state; only used for display and export）
concept.content: Body content sent to the recipient or endpoint. Templates may reference user attributes. （TEXT/VARCHAR type; webhooks.custom_body VARCHAR(255) defaults to empty string; providers.custom_body VARCHAR(255)）
concept.headers: HTTP headers sent with the request. Sensitive values should be stored as secrets. （VARCHAR(255)/JSONB type; webhooks.headers VARCHAR(255) defaults to empty string; webhooks.custom_headers JSONB defaults to empty object）
concept.url: Target URL including scheme, host, and path. Query parameters may be added by the system. （VARCHAR(255~2048) type; webhooks.url is VARCHAR(255); saml_metadata_url is VARCHAR(2048), the browser/HTTP URL ceiling）
concept.path: Path component appended to the service base URL. It must start with a slash. （VARCHAR(255) type; path appended after base_url, must start with a slash）
concept.prefix: Prefix prepended to generated values such as identifiers or codes. （VARCHAR(16~20) type; app_client_secrets.secret_prefix VARCHAR(16) fixed gl_cs_ + 6 random chars; llm_api_keys.key_prefix VARCHAR(20) fixed glk_）
concept.label: Display label for this entry. It is shown verbatim in the interface. （VARCHAR/TEXT type; alias for display_name field; for display only, no logic）
concept.value: Stored value of this entry. The allowed format depends on the field type. （Mixed type; value in JSONB or field value; format determined by type）
concept.default: Value used when no explicit input is provided. Leave empty to fall back to the system default. （Determined by schema default column; BOOLEAN often defaults to FALSE; INTEGER to 0; TIMESTAMPTZ to now()）
concept.limit: Upper bound enforced for this field. Requests exceeding it are rejected. （INTEGER/DECIMAL type; llm_api_keys.rpm_limit/tpm_limit INTEGER nullable; llm_api_keys.monthly_budget DECIMAL(19,4) nullable）
concept.quota: Quota granted to this scope. Once exhausted, further requests fail until the period resets. （INTEGER/DECIMAL type; organization_billing.default_quota INTEGER defaults to 0; llm_quota_policies.limit_value DECIMAL(19,4)）
concept.usage: Consumption recorded for the current period. It is recalculated from metering events. （INTEGER type; llm_usage_logs input_tokens/output_tokens/total_tokens are each INTEGER defaulting to 0; stored in monthly partitions）
concept.sorts: Sort order applied to the list, expressed as field and direction pairs. （JSONB/VARCHAR type; only used for frontend query sorting; no direct database constraint）
concept.filters: Filter conditions applied to the list. Multiple conditions are combined with AND. （JSONB/VARCHAR type; only used for frontend query filtering; no direct database constraint）
concept.gender: Gender recorded for this profile. It is optional and only used for display and analytics. （TEXT type; user_profiles.gender nullable; only used for display and analytics）
concept.bio: Short self-introduction shown on the profile card. Keep it free of secrets or personal contact details. （TEXT type; user_profiles.bio nullable; personal intro shown on profile card）
concept.realName: Legal name used for identity verification. It must match the identity document exactly. （TEXT type; user_profiles.real_name nullable; used for identity verification, must match identity document exactly）
concept.idCardType: Type of identity document being verified, such as ID card or passport. It decides which fields are required. （TEXT type; user_profiles.id_card_type nullable; determines which document fields need to be filled）
concept.idCard: Document number. It is stored encrypted, masked in the interface, and never returned in full by the API. （TEXT type; user_profiles.id_card nullable; stored encrypted, API only returns a mask）
concept.requestTimeoutMs: Maximum request wait time in milliseconds. After this duration the request is marked as timeout and counted toward the quota. llm_providers defaults to 30000ms.
concept.maxRetries: Number of automatic retries after a retryable failure. Retries reuse the same request body and headers; llm_providers defaults to 2.
concept.weight: Traffic weight for routes under the same alias. Higher value receives proportionally more requests; both llm_providers and llm_routes default to 1 (even distribution).
concept.rpmLimit: Maximum requests per minute allowed for this API key. INTEGER nullable on llm_api_keys; NULL means unlimited. Exceeded requests are rejected immediately.
concept.tpmLimit: Maximum tokens per minute allowed for this API key. INTEGER nullable on llm_api_keys; NULL means unlimited. Input and output tokens are summed together.
concept.monthlyBudget: Maximum monthly spend in selected currency (DECIMAL(19,4)); NULL means no cap. Once exhausted all requests are rejected until reset cycle.
concept.baseUrl: Complete upstream AI service base URL including scheme, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. llm_providers.base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL.
concept.apiKey: AI Gateway data-plane API key. On save, only Argon2id hash and SHA-256 fingerprint are persisted; original value never returns. llm_providers stores sealed + fingerprint separately.
concept.modelId: UUID identifier of a physical model row. llm_routes.model_id is a FK to llm_models. One provider must have unique provider_model_name per provider.
concept.providerModelName: Model name as defined by the upstream provider, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-3.5-sonnet. VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL; unique per provider.
concept.alias: Logical alias for callers to reference uniformly. Internally routes to concrete provider + model pairs. VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL; unique within organization.
concept.aliasId: UUID identifier of a logical alias row. llm_routes.alias_id FK references llm_model_aliases.id.
concept.maxContextTokens: Maximum context token count this model supports, including system prompt, history, and current input. INTEGER nullable; NULL means no limit.
concept.maxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens generated in a single call by this model. INTEGER nullable; NULL means no limit.
concept.inputPricePer1M: Billing unit price per 1M input tokens in selected currency. DECIMAL(19,4); defaults to 0 meaning no charge.
concept.outputPricePer1M: Billing unit price per 1M output tokens in selected currency. DECIMAL(19,4); defaults to 0 meaning no charge.
concept.effectiveFrom: Effective time for this price or policy version. TIMESTAMPTZ, default now(); only the record with the highest price_version where effective_from ≤ current time participates in billing or policy matching. Present in llm_quota_policies / llm_price_versions / llm_action_versions.
concept.resetCycle: Quota reset cycle. CHECK constraint daily/monthly; defaults to monthly. daily resets at 00:00 UTC each day; monthly resets on 1st of each month 00:00 UTC.
concept.preferredProtocol: Protocol face preferred by this provider. Decides request headers, auth method, and error code format. CHECK openai/anthropic/gemini; defaults to openai.
concept.capabilities: JSONB capabilities object on llm_models describing what the model supports (streaming, vision, tools, etc.). Defaults to empty object.
concept.supportedProtocols: List of upstream API protocol surfaces the provider is compatible with; options: openai (OpenAI-compatible), anthropic (Anthropic Native), gemini (Google Gemini Native); multi-select; llm_providers.supported_protocols JSONB nullable.
